patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — PrestaShop and Sellfy share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — PrestaShop and Sellfy share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose PrestaShop only if your buying job matches “Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 1” rather than Sellfy's shape. Choose Sellfy only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerc” rather than PrestaShop's shape. Workflow advantage: PrestaShop leans catalog-management; Sellfy leans digital-business-marketplace. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — PrestaShop and Sellfy share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: PrestaShop is Open-source PHP commerce — Classic free; Hosted from ~$26/mo annual (€24 excl. VAT) with 14-day trial; Enterprise quote. WooCommerce keeps t; Sellfy is Ecommerce platform for digital downloads and subscriptions — affiliate partner in ecommerce..
- Company-size focus: PrestaShop (small-business, mid-market) vs Sellfy (micro, small-business).
- Workflow coverage skew: PrestaShop-leaning catalog-management vs Sellfy-leaning digital-business-marketplace.
- Researched limits: PrestaShop — Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free; Sellfy — none listed.

Limitations — PrestaShop: Classic TCO (hosting, modules, agency) is not $0 even when the license is free; POS / omnichannel is module-dependent, not a native retail bundle; Sellfy: —.

V)
